statement: Identical Panel-3 MOP token identities will recur in the broad boundary role above the composition-conditioned null even when the paired genomes share no identical full 16-nt implementation for that token.
support_condition: Observed above frozen null mean and one-sided 100,000-replicate Monte Carlo p<=0.05; strong support p<=0.01.
weakening_condition: Observed above null mean but p>0.05.
contamination_boundary: Generated from v0.0.48 retrospective data but frozen before Panel-3 sequence acquisition.
